Validate an agent recipe and prepare stable retry identities without starting a session. Execute the plan with the generated Workbench session and prompt operations; retain the recipe and receipt. This scaffold leaves Copilot context behavior unchanged.
Read the active Workbench CSS and its host-owned file path. Edit workbench-theme.css at that path, then call ReloadWorkbenchTheme.

Reload the host-owned workbench-theme.css file after editing it. Missing or empty CSS restores the default; invalid UTF-8 or over 65536 bytes preserves the active theme. Browsers refresh within five seconds while visible. Use /ui/?theme=default to bypass broken CSS in one tab. No path or CSS input is accepted.

candace.brainspine.v1.AgentAssignmentPla.description:
A prepared recipe is inspectable data, not a dispatched or completed task.
Fingerprints bind evidence to the exact definition and complete recipe.

candace.brainspine.v1.AgentConfiguration.description:
Durable configuration receipt. It contains references only, never secret
values. revision implements compare-and-swap updates.

A complete replacement payload for one agent's external-tool configuration.
The authenticated transport selects the agent; callers cannot supply an ID.

candace.brainspine.v1.AgentDefinition.description:
Reusable worker configuration. Instructions guide the backend; they do not
grant permissions. The host retains its existing tool approval policy.

candace.brainspine.v1.AgentLangfuseConfi.description:
Agent-owned references for Langfuse. Secret material remains in the
operator-owned secret store; agents can only inspect and select their own
opaque references.

candace.brainspine.v1.AgentOpenSearchCon.description:
Agent-owned references for the rebuildable OpenSearch projection. The
evidence authority remains PostgreSQL and the artifact store.

candace.brainspine.v1.CommandReceipt.description:
Command execution evidence is generated into every consumer. Success means
the recorded command exited zero; it does not prove an arbitrary claim.

queued.description: Durable task accepted; indexing runs in the host's goroutine workers.

candace.brainspine.v1.KnowledgeKind.description: Evidence status is explicit: a model claim is not a checked theorem.

candace.brainspine.v1.MetricDefinition.description:
Measurements are registered as data before their first observation. Metric
names and units stay stable across runs; hashes and IDs are receipt fields,
not unbounded Prometheus label dimensions. Missing data is never zero.

candace.brainspine.v1.Opcode.description:
All expression values are dimensionless fixed-point scalars with scale 1000.
The simulator adapter owns physical-unit normalization; actuator conversion
is fixed by the spine, never supplied by a candidate. Every operation saturates
to [-1000000000, 1000000000]. SCALE divides by 1000 toward zero.

candace.brainspine.v1.ResearchEvent.description:
Exactly one payload is present. Consumers validate the metric registry,
finite values and receipt references before displaying observations.

cleanupConfirmed.description: True only after AWS reports a terminal job; not just TerminateJob acknowledgement.

reservationUsdMicros.description: Retained admission reservation, never represented as an AWS invoice.

candace.brainspine.v1.Simulator.description: Simulator jobs share the host's durable queue. Vendor SDKs own cloud wire types.

candace.brainspine.v1.SourceDocument.description:
A source revision cites immutable UTF-8 content in the artifact store. The
source's license is metadata, never inferred from the software ingesting it.

candace.brainspine.v1.WorkbenchTheme.description:
Read-only projection of the host-owned workbench-theme.css file. CSS is
trusted configuration applied after the built-in theme; empty means default.

filePath.description: Host filesystem path selected by composition, never supplied by an agent call.

google.rpc.Status.description: The Status type defines a logical error model suitable for different programming environments.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details.
